fullContentHtml:
UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the mains Result for the post of Assistant Teacher (TGT). This recruitment was released for 7466 posts. Applications for the UP LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Recruitment 2026 were accepted from April 02, 2026, to April 17, 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 13 June 2026 and 11 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UP LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 July 2025
  • Last Date : 28 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 August 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 04 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 06 December 2025 to 25 January 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 26 November 2025
  • Answer Key (Biology, English) : 28 January 2026
  • Result (Hindi, Math) : 05 February 2026
  • Result (Science, home Science, Sanskrit, Commerce) : 18 February 2026
  • Result (Urdu, Art, Agri/Horti, Music) : 12 March 2026 Available
  • Computer Exam Date : 05 April 2026
  • Computer Admit Card : 26 March 2026
  • Result Update : 01 April 2026
  • Mains Online Form
  • Application Start Date : 02 April 2026
  • Last Date : 17 April 2026
  • Mains Exam Date (Commerce) : 22 April 2026
  • Download Mains Admit Card (Commerce) : 16 April 2026
  • Mains Exam Date (Sanskrit) : 23 April 2026
  • Download Mains Admit Card (Sanskrit) : 17 April 2026
  • Mains Form (Computer)  : 23 June 2026 to 07 July 2026
  • Sociology, Physical Education, Music, Hindi Mains Exam Date : 11 July 2026
  • Sociology, Physical Education, Music, Hindi Mains Admit Card : 12 May 2026
  • Biology, Urdu Mains Exam Date : 13 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 06 June 2026
  • Computer Mains Exam Date : 16 August 2026
  • Computer Mains Admit Card : 11 August 2026
  • Mains Result : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 125/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • Ex-Service Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs.25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
